165113.overview:
While Yogi was taking his nap under a tree, Boo Boo wandered off to another national park. Playing as the part of Yogi, you must find the whereabouts of Boo Boo. Mr. Ranger, with his ranger radio and computer, is the only one who can help you besides the park maps in your hand. You will need to ask Mr. Ranger to use his radio and computer to get a brief description of the missing bear's last sighted location and find the national park on your park maps that matches the information. Then you have to fly the helicopter of Mr. Ranger to the park and see if Boo Boo is still there.

The game also lets you review the information of all the the National Parks and print out some quizzes without launching the main game.

175335.overview: Yellow Submarine is a freeware/public domain shooter game for the Apple II series of computers.  It was developed by Daniel Webster and released in 1988.

202284.overview:
Yahtzee is a text-based implementation of the popular dice game for the Apple II.

Players take turns rolling five dice, and the player can reroll any or all of the dice twice more before selecting their scoring category. Scoring categories include 6 categories within the Upper Section, which include the sum of all ones to sixes. If the sum of the upper category is 63 points or more, the player receives a 35 point bonus. In the Lower Section, the categories include 3 of a kind, 4 of a kind, full house, a 4 dice straight, a 5 dice straight, yahtzee (5 of a kind) and chance (which is the sum of all dice). A game is finished when all 11 scoring categories have been used. A computer opponent is available for competition.
